structuralMaterialResolver.policy: Structural salvage resolver is a release-gate feature check. Refine + Sell requires a concrete ship; CMAT Sell Only is ship-independent. Every known salvage ship must resolve to a versioned material mapping with provenance. The internal all-ships coverage baseline is diagnostic-only and must never reappear as a user option.

storageArchitecture.policy: Runtime controls and preferences must never depend on localStorage quota. IndexedDB is primary persistence; localStorage is legacy-only.

checks.expected: localStorage used only for one-time legacy migration/cleanup + diagnostic probe

dataPipeline.policy: Fetch narrowly, discover dynamically. New LIVE systems/facilities/prices are discovered from current source data; full source mirrors are not retained. Unknown new mechanics must fail visibly rather than be guessed.

checks.expected: location/terminal datasets requested per dynamically discovered LIVE system with safe fallback
no full paginated SC Wiki location crawl
only dynamically discovered salvage spaceships retained after discovery
CMAT/RMC and structural salvage commodities only

sellOnlyDirectCmat.policy: Sell Only treats the entered CMAT SCU as already-finished inventory. Recovery, refining loss, ship material mapping and ship-access filtering belong only to Refine + Sell; Sell Only CMAT results must remain identical across salvage-ship selections.

checks.expected: no gross→net conversion in Sell Only
identical CMAT sell locations/order/prices for no ship and every salvage ship
selected salvage ship cannot affect CMAT Sell Only tie-break ordering

uexDeepLinks.policy: Demand stays on UEX: material headings open the commodity demand page; each rendered result location opens that exact commodity + terminal demand view.

hangarCompleteness.policy: All operational refinery / CMAT-sale / RMC-sale facilities are audited independently. Hangar, Landing Pad, UEX pad_types and Docking are logged separately; S/M/L may use hangar or landing pad, XL requires a verified XL hangar + docking; an XL landing pad alone does not qualify.
